reviews.text: Thank you. 😊 …
Kind and professional
Thank you! We're glad you enjoyed your stay with us.

Paola remains a valuable resource. We've long searched for a guarantee in a world that often disappoints expectations, and we finally found it in her and the shop where she works! Quality products and unsurpassed professionalism! Thank you!

I've been taking my two elderly cats to Groom Room for a few months now.
My 20-year-old cat loves being bathed by Paola, who has become her favorite. She relaxes so much that I have to hold her up or she'll collapse.
My 15-year-old cuddly cat, on the other hand, demands my presence and only then will he let me lather him up and shower him without any problems, even though Paola is usually supported by another woman.
Paola is a friendly person with great empathy for the animals she treats. My cats always receive lots of cuddles and compliments from her. She talks to them while she cleans their ears and eyes with great care and gentleness.
The only thing that's a little challenging is drying them, but by putting a sort of cap over their ears, they both manage without too much stress.
I highly recommend this place and Paola to anyone who wants to entrust their beloved pet to reliable and caring hands.
Ah…I recommend booking well in advance, at least 1 week, if you want to be sure of finding a place on the agenda.

I'm now a regular customer at the center. Since I discovered it, I haven't left. Vittoria is a true animal lover, and it shows. She works with professionalism and patience, and above all, she's very attentive. My dog ​​always loves going there. Every time she leaves, she smells lovely and has a smooth, shiny coat. The products are truly excellent. I highly recommend it to everyone.

If I could give it zero stars, I would without hesitation.

An absolutely shameful experience in every way. I took my cat simply for a haircut. She's a cat accustomed to grooming, having already had it done over twenty times in the past without any problems. In this case, however, she left terrified by the groomer's behavior and with a BLEEDING PAW because her nail had been cut very deeply (I've attached a photo).

From the beginning, the situation was absurd: the groomer with short, colored hair (I think her name is Paola) asked me to personally intervene to hold the cat during the treatment. This had never happened to me at any other center. I take my pet to a professional precisely because I expect them to be able to handle the job independently.
Throughout the session, I was subjected to aggressive comments and extremely unprofessional behavior. I got angry because I didn't know how to do part of her job: caring for a cat. While cleaning my cat's ears, she made faces of disgust and even made vomiting noises, as if she were doing something disgusting. This behavior was offensive and unacceptable. When I pointed this out, she said, "It's not my problem if you're offended; your cat's ears were disgusting."

The hygienic conditions left me speechless: I saw dirty combs used, full of other animals' hair, and a bite prevention device that looked dirty and neglected. The place stank, and I won't comment on the floor...
But most importantly, due to my cat's obvious stress, I wanted to stop the grooming, but the groomer continued.

Despite the work remaining incomplete, I was still asked to pay the full amount. In the end, I paid €25 for a service that was never completed.

The conclusion was even worse: I was told that it's "clients like me" who aren't making enough money, and that I should be satisfied with the work done for that price, as if I were the one setting the prices for treatments.

Nonexistent professionalism, nonexistent attention to the animal's well-being, extremely questionable hygiene, and a complete lack of respect for the client.

Seeing my cat (who is my heart) look like this was truly the most terrifying thing of all.

I will never bring my cat to this place again, and I ABSOLUTELY do not recommend it to anyone.
Thank you for choosing our shop. ☺️
Mrs. Vittoria is a very competent person and respects her work ethic. She knows how to handle animals: a gentle voice and a firm, authoritative voice when necessary. Very serious and reliable.

I took my Pomeranian for a full grooming service, including a wash, nail trim, and more. The lady is very knowledgeable, and my dog ​​wasn't stressed by the treatment; she went home beautiful and smelling great. Highly recommended!
We took our 16-year-old "puppy" to be washed and sheared: we were super satisfied, he looked so much better, almost younger, and he's very satisfied too! 🐶 Thank you so much Victoria! …

The lady and the guy were very kind to my Nina, who, despite her advanced age and a bit of a tantrum, left the grooming spotless and smelling good. They also pay great attention to detail, including her ears and paws. Highly recommended, especially since they're open on Sundays too!

Rushed booking management, refusal to perform the service because more than two months had passed since the previous one. Unprofessional! I do not recommend. After the response...NO COMMENT at the bottom!

Fabulous place
I have a 15-year-old dog with a truly temperamental and peculiar personality who hates being touched, even becoming aggressive and biting.
Here she has finally found peace: she leaves the grooming salon stress-free (and looks beautiful too), and for the first time in 15 years, she no longer refuses to go to the groomer and leaves feeling relaxed. A huge thank you ❤️ My only regret? Discovering this fabulous place so late!!
Thank you☺️
Thank you. You're always welcome 🤗 …
Super happy, my Alvin was groomed very well! Super! 💪🏻 …
Very good 🙏🙏🙏 …

I rushed my two Labradors to be washed because they were completely covered in red paint. They cleaned them very well: they were white again, shiny, and smelled great! The lady and her son are two wonderful people, very kind.
Thank you so much, see you next time! 😊 …
While I was waiting, I heard the lady screaming like crazy at a little dog who started barking. At first I thought it was their dog, but then the owner arrived! I was speechless!!!
Great first experience! I took my ten-year-old dog here and was absolutely delighted. The only shame is that there's no glass to spy on! Overall, highly recommended.

Well done, Viktoria. I'd like to give you much more than 5 stars. I went to you with my Persian cat, over 10 years old, after a terrible experience with another groomer in the same area. He was very self-important and completely disrespectful of cats' needs and fears, and even dared to do to my cat what I had specifically asked not to do. Viktoria, on the other hand, was fantastic: fast, professional, and very respectful of my big cat. I should point out that today my Spink went to a specialist: the same veterinary ophthalmologist—who had seen him in May 2025 before the grooming—said that Spink had been extremely well-groomed. Well done, Viktoria!
They treated both us and our cat very well, highly recommended

They're really good. Ever since I discovered them, I've been going to them all the time. I always take my dog ​​and my mother's dog, who is a real devil. When they both go to the lady and her son, they're the most docile dogs in the world 😒😂 …

Found by chance because it was so close to home. Now a sure thing. We always take our Maltese (who has a difficult temperament) here. We're extremely satisfied with Paola's work, as she immediately created a special bond with the dog. Highly recommended!

First time I went: First, while I was waiting my turn with my dog, I heard the dog they were treating crying and the lady yelling, "I didn't do anything to you, what a fuss!" I wanted to leave, but since I'd be there, I tried to give her a chance. Speaking non-Italian to her colleague in front of me didn't seem very nice, but that's not important. The treatment went well, but I could see her impatient face when my dog ​​moved because she didn't want to be hair-dried. And speaking in their language made her nervous. The price is good, but honestly, I wouldn't leave my dog ​​alone with them. I'm not saying they'd hurt her, absolutely not, but they certainly wouldn't have a calm, reassuring voice. And in any case, smiling a little more wouldn't hurt.

I would recommend this shop to anyone I know who has a beloved pet. Victoria is so patient and kind, and her care speaks for itself. I've seen a beautiful cat emerge from it, looking gorgeous. Victoria has a great gift! She's always busy, and there's a reason for that: THEY ARE AMAZING! 5 STARS
I brought Millo, our Persian cat, who unfortunately has a lot of knots. He was treated with great care and professionalism! Well done!!!
Fantastic! If you need to enhance and keep your four-legged friend healthy, book an appointment here now! Very kind and super professional! More than 5 stars
We have a very good Amstaff, we can only say that we are very happy to have found this place where our Tyson gets a bath ❤️ from the attention and love with which they work. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Thanks 🙂 …
Very welcoming place, polite and very professional staff, I will definitely go back, my brunette after the treatment in this place seems like another dog, I recommend it top

After almost a year of taking my dog, I have always been satisfied with both the price and the grooming since July 2024. A person has been hired to help her, but the dog is no longer groomed as before, cut very badly and I am no longer satisfied with either the cut or the increased price. I am disappointed, I will not return.
The girls are so sweet! They did a great job. 100% recommended.
Animal-friendly. Excellent work. Good price.

I took my cat Frida to this grooming salon and was extremely satisfied with the experience. The staff was welcoming and professional, showing great compassion for Frida, who is usually quite shy. The grooming was performed with care and attention, respecting her time and making the process as stress-free as possible.
When I picked Frida up, she was perfectly clean, smelling fresh, and relaxed, a sign that she had been treated with care. Her fur was soft and shiny, and I couldn't help but notice how happy and comfortable she was. It's clear that the team loves animals and knows how to make them feel at ease.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for high-quality grooming for their furry friend. Frida and I will definitely be back!

Five stars are really not enough for this place. We found it by chance because everyone else was on vacation, and how lucky we were! Clean place, super friendly staff, and most importantly, they treated our Persian Milton like he was theirs, not only doing their job but pampering him the whole time. He was so relaxed after the shearing that he fell asleep on the table 😅❤️

Highly professional service! The owner took great care of my rabbit. ☺️ Thank you.
I highly recommend.

If you're looking for a place for your four-legged friend, this is the right place.
Highly recommended. Highly qualified, courteous, and professional staff.

I discovered this place by chance, and my usually lively and elusive puppy, Axel, had a great time here. He left happy and smelling good. They're truly excellent professionals who know how to put dogs at ease from the very first moment!
